content.short: Catalyst is a cross-chain AMM connecting all blockchains through shared liquidity pools, enabling seamless multi-chain token swaps without traditional bridges.
content.description: Catalyst is a novel cross-chain automated market maker that enables direct token swaps between any two supported blockchains without requiring traditional bridges or wrapped tokens. The protocol uses shared liquidity pools and cross-chain messaging to settle trades natively, acting as a universal liquidity layer for Web3. Catalyst connects Mantle and other isolated chain ecosystems into a unified trading network, making cross-chain swaps as simple as same-chain trades.
content.meta: Catalyst is a cross-chain AMM enabling seamless multi-chain swaps without bridges on Mantle. Discover Catalyst on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
